name: Aerospace Safety and Reliability Engineering
summary: Methods for making aerospace systems safe and reliable: hazard analysis, FMEA, fault trees, probabilistic risk and lessons from accidents.

topics.name: Reliability mathematics: failure rates, bathtub curve, exponential and Weibull models
System reliability: series, parallel, k-out-of-n and redundancy
Failure modes and effects (and criticality) analysis: FMEA/FMECA
Fault tree analysis and event trees
Human factors and human error in aerospace
Accident case studies: Apollo 1, Challenger, Columbia, Air France 447, 737 MAX
Parts, materials and processes (EEE parts, derating, screening)
